text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and closing restatement","quality":"thesis consistency","description":"It states a position early and returns to that position in the conclusion, giving the argument a clear through-line."},{"evidence":"points about fuel use, emissions, savings, and public transport","quality":"supporting evidence use","description":"It uses multiple article-based details to back up its claims instead of relying mainly on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on benefits, risks, law, then conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in distinct sections that are easier to follow and build toward a conclusion."},{"evidence":"mentions blame, accidents, and traffic law","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges objections and legal concerns and then tries to answer them rather than ignoring the opposing side."},{"evidence":"formal transitions like 'Despite' and 'As of now'","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses connecting phrases to link ideas and keep the essay moving logically from one point to the next."}]}
